data.change_summary: No persistent source edits were required in this apply-fixes pass: the requested DOC/DON rationale comment was already present in `breeding_success_state`, so this stage consisted of confirming that state, rerunning the shrimp scenario probe suite, and restoring a transient `docs/validation_scenarios.md` artifact generated during test execution.
outstanding_risks: The thermal-suppression probe still depends on seeded berried females plus a first-day 25->31 C heat shock; substantial future retunes to hatch timing or thermal egg-drop behavior may require fixture adjustment.

Successful summary traces are still written to deterministic `/tmp/tank_harness/.../trace.jsonl` paths, so rerunning the same seeded summary probe overwrites the prior success artifact bundle for that scenario label.
The worktree still contains unrelated pre-existing modifications in `.claude/worktrees/tanksim-6e5.4.7` and untracked `.ralph-burning/`; they were left untouched.

steps.description: Inspect the approved follow-up note and verify whether `breeding_success_state` already contains the requested DOC/DON rationale comment in the current source.

Confirm the requested comment is already present in `crates/tank_harness/tests/e2e_shrimp_scenario_probes.rs`, so no new source patch is needed, and clean the transient validation-doc artifact produced by the test run.
Re-run the shrimp scenario probe suite and workspace checks to verify the deliverable remains green after this no-op confirmation pass.

validation_evidence: `git show HEAD:crates/tank_harness/tests/e2e_shrimp_scenario_probes.rs | sed -n '374,382p'` showed the requested DOC/DON rationale comment already present above `dissolved_organic_carbon_mg_c_total` and `dissolved_organic_nitrogen_mg_n_total` in `breeding_success_state`.
`rg -n "Keep DOC/DON as low absolute totals" crates/tank_harness/tests/e2e_shrimp_scenario_probes.rs` returned line 379, confirming the live workspace contains the same breeding-fixture explanation.
`cargo test -p tank_harness --test e2e_shrimp_scenario_probes -- --nocapture` passed; all 6 shrimp probe tests succeeded, including the summary runner with all 5 scenarios reported as PASS.

After restoring the test-generated documentation artifact, `git diff -- docs/validation_scenarios.md` returned no output and `git status --short` showed only the unrelated pre-existing `.claude/worktrees/tanksim-6e5.4.7` modification and untracked `.ralph-burning/` directory.
